name: Gang Style Feature
summary: Gang Style Feature Gunslinger Your first pistol hit each turn deals +1d6 damage if the target is within 30 ft. Knife Rat When you score a critical hit with a light melee weapon, the target cannot take reactions until its next turn. Chem-User Once per long rest, ignore the exhaustion risk from your combat chems. descriptionMarkdown:
Gang Style Feature
Gunslinger
Your first pistol hit each turn deals 
+1d6 damage if the target is within 
30 ft.
Knife Rat
When you score a critical hit with a 
light melee weapon, the target 
cannot take reactions until its next 
turn.
Chem-User
Once per long rest, ignore the 
exhaustion risk from your combat 
chems.
Gang Style Feature
Sump Ghost
Once per short rest, become 
hidden from one creature even if it 
can see you, provided there is 
cover, smoke, steam, machinery, 
darkness, or a crowd within 10 ft.
